I studied physics at the University of Bologna, and I work as a private STEM tutor.

This site is where I write up what I'm working on — mostly as it happens, rather than after it's finished.

Expect notes with loose ends in them.

**Right now I'm working on:** 

* Structure and Interpretation of Classical Mechanics
* Deep Learning with Python 2nd ed.
